scheme_name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Permanent Partial Disability
other_conditions: Applicant must have a permanent partial disability (one eye or one leg non‑functional due to accident or paralysis).
Age is calculated as of 1 July of any year.
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of ₹37,500 to eligible workers or craftsmen with permanent partial disability.
